title: Checkpoint Hardening — structured footprint, auto last-green, guard

steps: checkpoint-lint.sh exits 0 on a clean checkpoint with no Footprint entries
checkpoint-lint.sh exits 0 when Footprint entry is 'none'
checkpoint-lint.sh exits 0 for a valid file:start-end::STATUS entry
checkpoint-lint.sh exits 1 and prints a message for a prose Footprint entry
checkpoint-lint.sh exits 1 for a missing :: delimiter
checkpoint-lint.sh exits 1 for an unknown STATUS token
checkpoint-lint.sh accepts all three status tokens: WIP, DONE, REVIEW

slices.description: bin/checkpoint-snapshot.sh — deterministic line-range snapshot with boundary defense
steps: checkpoint-snapshot.sh exits 1 with a usage error when no argument is given
checkpoint-snapshot.sh exits 1 with 'file not found' for a missing file
checkpoint-snapshot.sh exits 1 with 'out of bounds' for a range exceeding file length
checkpoint-snapshot.sh exits 0 and writes a snapshot file for a valid entry
snapshot file content matches the exact lines from the source file
snapshot path is deterministic (same input → same path)
checkpoint-guard.sh exits 0 (proceed) when no previous checkpoint exists
checkpoint-guard.sh exits 0 when git diff reports changed files
checkpoint-guard.sh exits 1 (suppress) with a message when no files changed
checkpoint-guard.sh exits 0 when staged changes exist even if working tree is clean

slices.description: bin/ctx-hook.sh extension — auto-stamp last-green.txt when tests pass
steps: ctx-hook.sh stamps last-green.txt with timestamp and rev when HARNESS_TEST_SCRIPT passes
ctx-hook.sh does not stamp last-green.txt when HARNESS_TEST_SCRIPT fails
ctx-hook.sh skips test stamp when HARNESS_TEST_SCRIPT is unset
ctx-hook.sh still exits 0 in all cases (best-effort contract)
last-green.txt content matches 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ rev=<sha>' format
checkpoint SKILL.md Footprint field documents file:start-end::STATUS notation
checkpoint SKILL.md Last green field references .trace/runtime/last-green.txt
README.md bin/ reference table lists checkpoint-lint.sh, checkpoint-snapshot.sh, checkpoint-guard.sh
